Maya: Quick heads-up — Orion pilot: they won’t onboard unless we provide per-route model pins + daily token CSVs + immutable policy audit. Need a short triage.
Ethan: Noted. Competitor already ships per-route pins + per-call cost breakdown. Fast path for us might be route-tags + attach pin at auth-time to avoid per-request lookups.
Ravi: Sales says they also need a rollback window for pins (auto-revert after X days) and canary toggles so they can validate pinned routes. They want cost alerts for routes that cross thresholds.
Claire: Two engineering approaches: 1) implement lookup on the hot path (simpler) or 2) embed pin info in tenant JWT at auth (adds complexity at auth but reduces runtime impact). Spike to validate perf/security tradeoffs.
Maya: Proposed launch criteria for Orion pilot: 1) Pin API for routes 2) Daily CSV export with tenant, route, model, tokens, cost 3) p99 added latency <150ms for pinned routes 4) immutable audit entries (tamper-evident hash). If we meet these they will sign pilot.
Ethan: Tech estimate: spike 1w to compare auth-attach vs in-memory map (measure p99), alpha Pin API & minimal console + export hook in next sprint. Full parity (policy UI, long-term audit storage) in Q3.
Ravi: Orion will accept alpha if we include explicit roadmap and a demo in 3 weeks. I can get a signed pilot clause.
Claire: Differentiation idea: offer "billing buckets" per route so customers can tag routes to internal cost centers (helpful for chargebacks). Could be a net positive vs parity-only response.
Ethan: Quick API sketch (alpha):
```http
POST /v1/routes/pins
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "route": "orders/create",
  "model": "redwood/opt-2.7b-q4",
  "effective_from": "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z",
  "auto_revert_days": 14
}
```
Response returns pin_id + audit_hash.
Ravi: I'll draft the Orion pilot letter once we have spike timeline. Sales will include a demo clause and rollback SLAs.
Maya: Owners & rough dates: Spike (Ethan) - 7d; Pin API (Ravi) - 1 sprint; Export CSV (Maya) - 1 sprint; Console canary UI (Claire) - 10d; Sales pilot doc (Ravi) - 3d.
sales-bot: staging/pin-alpha created by Ravi  https://staging.internal/redwood/pin-alpha :rocket:
Ethan: I'll post perf numbers from the spike here. If auth-attach meets p99 target we avoid touching hot path.
Maya: Good. Sync Wed 4pm to lock commit vs de-scope. :thumbsup:
